method: UnityPy static asset walk: RectTransform/Canvas native fields + MonoBehaviour script class resolution via m_Script MonoScript; no game launch.

uiscaler.auto_resolution_factor: ScreenResolutionFactor = min(Screen.height/1080, Screen.width/1920) when AutomaticallyDetectScreenResolution is on, else the closest landmark setting value
uiscaler.note: CanvasScaler serialized referenceResolution/matchWidthOrHeight are not readable without script typetrees; UIScale is a user setting (default 1.0).

gaps.monobehaviour_fields: Image.sprite/color/type/fillAmount, TMP_Text font/size/alignment/color, CanvasScaler referenceResolution/match, layout-group paddings and UIScript references are serialized in MonoBehaviours whose typetrees are stripped: UnityPy reads the component class via m_Script but not its fields. Geometry (RectTransform) and Canvas fields ARE exact. Fill the gap with a runtime plugin UI dump (same approach as ParityDump /d/feeding) or join spec-dev's ui_atlas.json + Here/ defaults for sprites/fonts.
gaps.sprite_font_resolution: not resolvable statically from MonoBehaviour fields; resolve via tools/ui/ui_atlas.json (logical asset names) + Here/ inspector defaults, or the recommended runtime plugin dump.
gaps.canvas_scaler_values: CanvasScaler serialized values unreadable; formula from Here/Utility/UIScaler.cs is included in uiscaler above (scaleFactor = ScreenResolutionFactor * UIScale; auto factor = min(h/1080, w/1920)).
